Absorption Energy Manipulation

The Gedo Statue's Phantom Dragon Nine Seals (Naruto) massacre an army of Hidden Rain Ninjas by removing their souls from their bodies.

Power/Ability to:

Manipulate absorption energy.

The power to manipulate absorption energy. Variation of Absorption and Energy Manipulation. Not to be confused with Energy Absorption or Parasitic Energy Manipulation.

Also Called[]

  • Absorption Energy Control
  • Assimilation/Drainage/Leeching/Swallowing Energy Control/Manipulation

Capabilities[]

The user can create, shape and manipulate energy that can absorb, assimilate and/or leech off of targets. This allows one to drain or feed off of the targeted concept, material or power (physical/chemical properties, other types of energy, elements, organic substances, concept, powers, etc.). Unlike Parasitic Energy Manipulation, this type does not have to directly inflict damage.

Applications[]

  • Absorption
    • Absorption Constructs
    • Absorption Empowerment
    • Metabolization
  • Absorption Energy Generation
  • Affinity
  • Cultivation

Techniques[]

  • Absorption Arts
  • Absorption Combat
  • Absorption Infusion
  • Absorption Mode

Variations[]

  • Absorption Magic

Associations[]

  • Energy Manipulation

Limitations[]

  • Absorption Immunity/Absorption Negation/Anti-Energy Manipulation/Energy Absorption/Energy Erasure/Energy Negation
  • Energy may be difficult to control.
  • May not be able to absorb certain targets (element, object, power, etc.).
  • May need medium for absorbing certain targets.

Gallery[]

Yhwach (Bleach) using Auswählen to take the powers, and life-force, of other Quincy to empower himself or to revive his fallen Sternritter elites.
Using Sklaverei, Quincy such as Quilge Opie (Bleach) can absorb any spiritual matter around themselves...

Theresa (Class of the Titans)
Danny Fenton/Phantom (Danny Phantom)
Kurapika (Hunter x Hunter) can use his Nen to create his Steal Chain to drain/assimilate an opponent's abilities.
Sabine (The Order of the Stick) using Energy Drain to leech Durkon's life energy.
Xykon (The Order of the Stick) casting and using Maximized Energy Drain on Vaarsuvius' Soul Splice.
Ban (Nanatsu no Taizai/The Seven Deadly Sins) using Physical Hunt.
Nagato (Naruto) using the Blocking Technique Absorption Seal/Jutsu Absorption to absorb chakra from a technique with the Gakido/Preta Path.
Madara Uchiha (Naruto) using the Preta Path's Blocking Technique Absorption Seal to absorb an attack.
Urashiki Ōtsutsuki (Boruto: Naruto Next Generations) uses his Fishing Rod to steal Shikadai and Temari's chakra and use it for his own by loading them in his gourd.
Under the full moon, Tsukiyo (Boruto: Naruto Next Generations) is able to use his Moon Shadow Technique at its full potential which he can manifest the target's shadow as tangible clones....
...that are uniquely do not have a separate source of chakra, but rather draw their chakra from the target they were spawned from, effectively making the target tire twice as fast.
Fūka (Naruto) draining Naruto's chakra using her Execution by Kiss technique, which allows her to gain his life force and elemental chakra affinity, as well as enforcing her own.
Giga Drain (Pokémon) is a move that uses green energy to sap away at the energy of the target.
Gengar (Pokémon) using Dream Eater on Blue, trapping him in a dream and devouring his life energy.
Yveltal (Pokémon) using Oblivion Wing to generate an energy blast that absorbs the life energy from the target.
Mienfoo (Pokémon) using Drain Punch to infuse its fist with a health-absorbing effect.
When Tommy Brazen (Final Boss) defeats an opponent, he generates an energy that absorbs their powers...
...& can use said energy to enhance objects.
